description: Divider for clocks and gates with a ratio of 1 to 32, set by a switch and by voltage, passing on one pulse of every N it receives with the width of that pulse kept

params.text: Scales the voltage at the CV input before it reaches the division ratio, from -100% at one end through nothing at the centre to +100% at the other
Steps the division ratio through whole numbers from 1 to 32

inputs.text: Voltage that shifts the division ratio, added to the DIVISION setting once the CV knob has scaled it; 10V at full amount covers the whole range
The pulses being counted; the count advances on each rising edge
A rising edge here sets the count back to the start, so that the next pulse received counts as the first

outputs.text: Carries the first pulse of each division cycle, at the width of the incoming pulse and 10V high
Carries the last pulse of each division cycle, at the width of the incoming pulse and 10V high

notes: the display shows the division ratio in use, knob and voltage together
reducing the division while the module is running sets the N output if the count has already reached or passed the new value

inputs.1: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
